after.rosterkit/notices.py:
# owner: platform
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student


def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student, the days missed and the dates in order.

    Raises ValueError if any mark belongs to another student or if none of the
    marks is an absence.
    """
    all_marks = list(marks)
    for mark in all_marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id} given with student {student.student_id}"
            )
    dates = sorted({mark.day for mark in all_marks if mark.status == "absent"})
    if not dates:
        raise ValueError(f"no absences for student {student.student_id}")
    unit = "day" if len(dates) == 1 else "days"
    listing = ", ".join(item.isoformat() for item in dates)
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian,\n"
        f"\n"
        f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {len(dates)} {unit} of school.\n"
        f"Dates absent: {listing}."
    )

# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.student = Student("1001", "Thistle", "Bram", "A")

    def test_names_student_count_and_sorted_dates(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 9), "absent"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 4), "present")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(self.student, marks)
        self.assertIn("Bram Thistle missed 2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("Dates absent: 2026-03-02, 2026-03-09.", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = absence_notice(self.student, [Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day of", text)

    def test_repeated_date_counts_once(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")
        ]
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day of", absence_notice(self.student, marks))

    def test_other_students_mark_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("1002", date(2026, 3, 3), "absent")
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(self.student, marks)

    def test_no_absences_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(self.student, [Mark("1001", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")])

    def test_no_marks_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(self.student, [])
